name: Sakura Kozue
source:
Anchor of a news program for which the main character serves as director. She is mainly in charge of sports news.

She is a cheerful and vivacious sports girl who loves to be physically active. she is good friends with her colleague, Maria.

She has no interest in sex and is a virgin.

[From [url=https://gyutto.com/i/item1768?select_uaflag=1]Gyutto[/url]]
